summary: YXT.COM Group Holding Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting a registered direct offering of 150,000 ADSs at $7.00 per ADS, each representing 30 Class A ordinary shares, for gross proceeds of $1,050,000. The offering was made under an existing Form F-3 shelf registration and a prospectus supplement dated August 6, 2026. The company will use net proceeds for R&D, infrastructure, marketing, and strategic acquisitions. The placement agent was Univest Securities, LLC. Directors and officers entered into 30-day lock-up agreements. This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation; no deal terms beyond price per ADS and gross proceeds are applicable.
